entries.note: The first scan in JYTWL's hands, at its Guangzhou warehouse.
The parcel leaves the Guangzhou operation centre.
China's export clearance done, before the flight: the parcel is not held.

entries.wording: 预计配载航班…,Expected flight on …
entries.note: The flight the parcel is expected to board, its day in Chinese and in English read as ellipses. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
The postal dispatch announced to the exchange office that takes the parcel in Europe, before the take-off.

entries.wording: 航班已起飞,The flight has taken off from the origin
entries.note: The flight to Amsterdam left; the line writes the row in Chinese and English.

entries.wording: 航班已到达,清关拆板中 The flight has arrived, customs clearance and unpacking are underway

entries.note: The arrival notice at Amsterdam's airport, the morning after the landing.

entries.wording: 目的港已提货 Delivery has been made at the destination port
entries.note: The parcel collected from the destination airport.
The exchange office in Europe received the parcel.
The parcel presented to Dutch customs, minutes before the clearance.
Import clearance done in the Netherlands: the parcel goes on.

entries.wording: 货物已清关完成 Import customs clearance complete
entries.note: The line's own record of the import clearance: the parcel goes on.
The exchange office sends the parcel on to Posti.
Posti's scan at a terminal, copied: received at the terminal.
Posti's scan, copied: loaded onto the vehicle that delivers it, here to a pick-up point.
Posti's scan, copied: delivered to the pick-up point, not yet collected.
Posti's "Lähetys noudettavissa", copied: ready to collect at the pick-up point. GBK gives its ä as a question mark, kept as received.
Posti's "Lähetys haettu noutopisteestä", copied: collected from the pick-up point. GBK gives its ä as question marks, kept as received.
